title: When located inside the building, each regulator shall be provided with a vent pipe that leads directly to the outdoor air.
officialText:
The
vent pipe shall be sized according to local utility requirements. The vent outlet shall not be located under a window or any opening
leading back into the premises or located below any overhang or projection. No gas regulator vent outlet shall be covered over,
plugged up, or otherwise obstructed, and all gas vents shall be identified by suitable marking on the outlet on the outside o f the
building.
